scoring_justification: Result-level comparison of deterministic model predictions to experimental reference values with absolute tolerance; no raw-artifact recompute required.

hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's Table 1 and approved plan.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the experimentally measured values reported in the source publication, used as a validity check for the model predictions.

outputs.description: Predicted Young's modulus for the four conditions (0.05 and 0.1 wt% CNT, without and with MA). The values are compared to hidden experimental reference values.

output_contract.notes: The predicted values are compared to hidden experimental reference data for the same conditions. The comparison uses an absolute tolerance.
